verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks, explicitly including security awareness training completion. That implies training is assigned and its completion is tracked in-product. Nothing shows built-in training content, automatic assignment on hire, or that completion records serve as audit evidence. missing for 10: evidence of built-in training content, assignment triggered on hire/onboarding, completion records accepted as audit evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
